assertions.assertion: Injects ISpaceContextAccessor into a scoped UI service and reads the resolved SpaceId
assertions.rationale: BrandingService injects ISpaceContextAccessor and calls spaces.GetSpaceId() in a scoped UI service.

assertions.assertion: States Spaces do not add per-space UI/branding; you load your own space-aware settings
assertions.rationale: States there is 'no built-in per-space branding' and you load your own settings.

assertions.assertion: Advises preferring the resolved space over trusting a client-supplied tenant: acr_values hint
assertions.rationale: Says do not use acr_values tenant hint (untrusted, client-supplied) and prefer ISpaceContextAccessor.

assertions.assertion: Notes space resolution is independent of acr_values and runs before routing
assertions.rationale: Says space is resolved server-side at the start of each request, not via acr_values, with UseSpaceResolution before UseRouting.
